packageRules.description: Automerge only pin/pinDigest updates: they record the exact ref of an already-referenced version and introduce no new upstream code. Every other update requires a human merge.

Don't offer updates to the npm pin under constraints: it must match the npm version CI runs (Node 26 ships npm 11), not the newest npm. Raise it in the same change that moves CI to a newer npm; scripts/tests/npm-constraint.test.ts fails CI until then.
A Node major brings a newer bundled npm. Remind whoever merges it to raise constraints.npm in the same PR, since updates to that pin are switched off above.
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** this Node version may bundle a newer npm. Check `npm --version` in this PR's CI log and set `constraints.npm` in `renovate.json` to match, in this same PR.
